adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the mutation persists new attendees via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})` before calling `getUsersCredentials` / constructing `EventManager` and then `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` (all outside any transaction/try-catch). If any of those later steps throws, the request fails (500) after the DB write, and emails are not sent (email sending is the only part wrapped in try/catch). On retry, the handler recomputes `uniqueGuests` by filtering out emails already present in `booking.attendees`, which would now include the previously-added guests, leading to `uniqueGuests.length === 0` and a BAD_REQUEST `emails_must_be_unique_valid`. This creates a verifiable non-atomic partial-success failure mode grounded in the diff.
